items.title: Frank Strazzeri interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: My first album was with Terry Gibbs... Al McKibbon was on bass

ctx.x: Well listen, when was the first time that you got to actually record, that you thought this is a significant event for me, this recording out here? The first time you got to play with someone on a record.

Oh, the first one I recorded with was Terry Gibbs. And in a lifetime of playing you do a lot of recordings, it’s all part of the business you know. And I remember the first one as well as I remember yesterday. I may have forgotten a whole bunch of them, which I have, but you don’t forget the first one. The first one was like, wow, it was really a big thing. My first album was with Terry Gibbs. And I also remember who was on that, and I can’t remember hardly anyone that’s on records. I can’t even remember the name…
Al McKibbon — but he’s out here now.
